# Loona Salary & Tax Calculators by Loona Automation
Free gratuity, end-of-service, net salary and income tax calculators for the UAE, Saudi Arabia, the Netherlands, Germany, Spain and Pakistan. All calculators are free with no sign-up, run 100% client-side in the visitor's browser (no data leaves the device), and are built on formulas sourced from official labour and tax law, with the source and last-verified date shown on each page. Results are estimates, not tax or legal advice.

https://salary.loonaautomation.com/ — Homepage: index of all Loona salary, gratuity and tax calculators for the Gulf and Europe, with guides.
https://salary.loonaautomation.com/uae-gratuity-calculator/ — UAE Gratuity Calculator: end-of-service gratuity under Article 51 of Federal Decree-Law 33/2021 (21 days of basic wage per year for the first 5 years, 30 days after, capped at two years' wage; resignation does not reduce it).
https://salary.loonaautomation.com/saudi-end-of-service-calculator/ — Saudi End of Service Calculator: EOSB award under Articles 84-85 of the Saudi Labour Law (half a month's wage per year for the first 5 years, a full month after; resignation scale of 0, one third, two thirds or full).
https://salary.loonaautomation.com/netherlands-salary-calculator/ — Netherlands Salary Calculator: gross-to-net for 2026 with Box 1 tax, general and labour tax credits, 8% holiday allowance and the 30% ruling (salary norm and 2027 change to 27% included).
https://salary.loonaautomation.com/pakistan-salary-tax-calculator/ — Pakistan Salary Tax Calculator: salary income tax on the Finance Act 2026 slabs for Tax Year 2026-27 (salaried surcharge abolished), with the 2025-26 table as a selector.
https://salary.loonaautomation.com/germany-salary-calculator/ — Germany Gross-to-Net Calculator: brutto to netto in English using the exact statutory tariff of section 32a EStG (2026), tax classes including splitting for class III, solidarity surcharge, church tax and all four employee social contributions.
https://salary.loonaautomation.com/uae-final-settlement-calculator/ — UAE Final Settlement Calculator: gratuity under Article 51 plus unused annual-leave pay on the basic wage and notice-period pay on the full wage, itemised; the leave and notice bases are labelled contract-dependent.
https://salary.loonaautomation.com/saudi-salary-calculator/ — Saudi Salary Calculator (GOSI net pay): no income tax; GOSI employee deduction for Saudi nationals only (9.75% old system; 10.75% new system from 1 July 2026) on basic plus housing, floored at SAR 1,500 and capped at SAR 45,000; expats 0%.
https://salary.loonaautomation.com/qatar-gratuity-calculator/ — Qatar Gratuity Calculator: Article 54 of Labour Law 14/2004 — gratuity as agreed in the contract with a legal floor of 21 days of basic wage per year; input for a better contract rate; no resignation reduction.
https://salary.loonaautomation.com/kuwait-indemnity-calculator/ — Kuwait Indemnity Calculator: Articles 51-53 of Labour Law 6/2010 for monthly-paid staff — 15 days per year for five years at the divide-by-26 daily rate, one full month per year after, Article 53 resignation scale, 18-month cap; the wage-basis and post-year-5 method choices are disclosed on the page.
https://salary.loonaautomation.com/oman-gratuity-calculator/ — Oman Gratuity Calculator: Article 61 of RD 53/2023 — one month of basic wage per year for service from 1 August 2023, old-law rates (15 days per year for the first three years, then one month) for earlier service, all on the last basic wage.
https://salary.loonaautomation.com/bahrain-indemnity-calculator/ — Bahrain Indemnity Calculator: leaving indemnity under Article 116 of Legislative Decree 36/2012 for workers outside social insurance — half a month per year for the first three years, one month per year after, on basic wage plus social allowance; no cap.
